```yaml
name: Copilot Setup Steps

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  copilot-setup:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Setup Ruby
        uses: ruby/setup-ruby@v1
        with:
          ruby-version: '3.0'
          bundler-cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          gem install bundler
          bundle install

      - name: Run RuboCop
        run: bundle exec rubocop

      - name: Run Unit Tests
        run: bundle exec rspec spec/unit

      - name: Run Integration Tests
        uses: actionshub/test-kitchen@main
        env:
          CHEF_LICENSE: accept-no-persist
          KITCHEN_LOCAL_YAML: kitchen.dokken.yml
        with:
          suite: package
          os: centos-stream-10

      - name: Run Platform-Specific Tests
        run: |
          # Test PCRE2 support for RHEL >= 10
          echo "Testing PCRE2 detection for RHEL 10..."
          bundle exec rspec spec/unit/recipes/install_spec.rb -f d
          
          # Test PCRE version detection logic
          echo "Testing platform version detection logic..."
          bundle exec rspec spec/unit/libraries/helpers_spec.rb -f d

      - name: Validate Documentation
        run: |
          # Check for documentation updates
          if [ -f "CHANGELOG.md" ]; then
            echo "CHANGELOG.md exists"
          else
            echo "ERROR: CHANGELOG.md is missing"
            exit 1
          fi
          
          if [ -f "README.md" ]; then
            echo "README.md exists"
          else
            echo "ERROR: README.md is missing"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Verify PCRE Logic
        run: |
          # Verify the fix for PCRE2 support on RHEL >= 10
          echo "Verifying PCRE2 logic implementation..."
          grep -r "pcre2" spec/ || echo "No PCRE2 references found in specs"
          grep -r "RHEL.*10" spec/ || echo "No RHEL 10 references found in specs"

      - name: Final Validation
        run: |
          echo "All setup steps completed successfully"
          echo "Repository ready for PCRE version detection fixes"
```
